data.name: Tapishwar
data.long_meaning: Tapishwar is a powerful Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, composed of the prefix 'Tapi' and the suffix 'ishwar'. 'Tapi' means 'strong' and 'ishwar' means 'god'. Thus, Tapishwar can be translated as 'God of Power'.
